presentationSite.title: We have several types of locations :

item1.content: south-facing (with the shade of your tent or caravan), a magnificent 180° view of the Dent Parrachée and the Vanoise National Park. 2 pitches per terrace. Ideal for enjoying the view and the sun.
item1.title: Panoramic terraces:

item2.content: in the shade in the morning and at lunchtime with a magnificent view.
item2.title: Individual terraces:

item3.content: Located at 1250m. The hottest hours are between 12 and 4pm. Nights remain cool, so the sun is quite welcome, especially in the morning and evening. If you plan to be out and about almost every day, don't necessarily look for shade!
